about_the_game:
Legendary Bestiaries: SWARMS

Creepy Crawly Critters

SWARMS is a beautiful bestiary for 5th Edition featuring 80 spectacular swarms of killer creatures perfect for your campaign! Within these pages, you'll find clouds and carpets of spiders and centipedes, wasps and snakes, including common vermin and monstrous variants like the vampire bat swarm and horribulous rat swarm. This creature collection also features tons of all-new swarms from the elemental gravelbugs and living wildfire to the sinister dead ink swarm, unquiet ash,  and  nettler demons;  weirdness like the  swarm of wonder, fairy rings, hexagnomes, neutron starlings,  and  whispering heralds;  and whimsical challenges like animated silverware, finger-crushing lobsters, hungry penguins, and the  floofy kitten swarm ! These monsters are beautifully illustrated and feature creatures from aberrations to dragons and fey to undead ranging from Challenge 1/4 to 21, so you'll always have a swarm perfect for your PCs no matter their level!

This book is the latest awesome addition to our Legendary Bestiary series, featuring spectacular softcovers like  Asian Monsters, Latin American Monsters, Mechanical Monsters, Mediterranean Monsters, Mythos Monsters ,  and  Sea Monsters , as well as the massive hardcover  Alien Bestiary  and  Faerie Bestiary ! These bestiary books are available in  PDF and print as well as your favorite VTT! Check out this amazing product adapted from the 88-page 5E bestiary and Make Your Game Legendary!
